comparison_limits: Raw EFLAGS are retained; audit defined bits of the original final/fault instruction before comparison.
Unicorn MXCSR sticky flags are not host hardware authority; native/literal C++ must match full host FP and errno.
Inactive physical x87 payloads are diagnostic; compare source ABI live logical x87 state appropriately.
Raw accesses retain Unicorn widths/order; do not silently equate them with generated vector/provider observer granularity.
Write hooks include attempted writes. next_instruction_observed plus final region bytes distinguish fault prefixes.
Image input windows cover observed data reads only; executable original code is independently hash-pinned, not embedded.
No growth/fatal owner was stubbed; these selected cases do not qualify growth/fatal continuation or arbitrary callbacks.
scope: Actual unchanged TU1.5 original complete service/fault prefixes in Unicorn, explicit standalone ABI. No generated/native C++ execution or live caller admission.
xmm_encoding: 128-bit numeric hexadecimal; byte regions/operands are little-endian memory hex
